latest_features: AutoMapart now defers retries per missing target block position instead of repeatedly stalling on the same unplaceable spot
Added configurable AutoMapart safety sliders: Missing Notify CD, Missing Retry CD, and Place Recheck
AutoMapart now waits a configurable placement recheck window before reprocessing just-placed targets to reduce ghost disappearance
AutoMapart target selection/build passes now skip deferred and recheck-pending positions so it keeps placing what is currently available
AutoMapart default safety timings were increased for more stable behavior on laggy servers
